# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

* Version 0.1.x: Supported with active security updates

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Zploy, please report it responsibly:

* Please do NOT open a public issue on GitHub.
* Email security disclosures directly to `security@kiyogo.dev` or use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting at `https://github.com/kiyogo/zploy/security/advisories/new`.
* Provide detailed steps to reproduce the issue along with a minimal proof-of-concept if possible.
* You will receive an acknowledgment within 48 hours and regular updates on fix progress.

Thank you for helping keep Zploy and its users secure!
